scholarships.title: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
scholarships.official_source: Study in NL (Nuffic) — financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and Dutch higher education institutions

existing.description: The NL Scholarship is the Dutch national scholarship programme for bachelor and master students from outside the European Economic Area. It is financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science together with Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. Study in NL states the scholarship amounts to € 5,000 and is paid in the first year of studies, and explicitly notes that it is not a full-tuition scholarship. Institutions set their own application deadlines and their own amount tiers, so the value and the deadline both depend on the institution you apply to.
eligibility: You are applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at one of the participating Dutch higher education institutions.
You meet the specific requirements of the institution of your choice. You can find these on the website of the institution.
You do not have a degree from an education institution in the Netherlands.
Radboud University: You must not be eligible for the lower EU/EEA tuition fee for other reasons.

Radboud University: You must have (will obtain) a Bachelor's degree achieved outside the Netherlands, have no degrees achieved in the Netherlands and did not receive any previous education in the Netherlands (exchange programmes excluded, provided that they are part of the Bachelor's degree achieved outside the Netherlands).
Radboud University: You must meet the English language proficiency requirement for the Master's programme of your choice.
Radboud University: You must be able to comply with the conditions for obtaining a visa for the Netherlands.
Utrecht University: You must not be eligible for statutory tuition fees.

Utrecht University: You must never have been enrolled at an educational institution in the Netherlands (if you only took part in an exchange programme in the Netherlands, this does not make you ineligible).
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be of non-EEA nationality, be applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch institution, meet that institution's own requirements, and not hold a degree from a Dutch education institution.
benefits: At Radboud University the NL Scholarship is always combined with the Radboud Scholarship Programme (RSP): applicants must also apply for the RSP, and can be awarded both or just the RSP, never the NLS alone.
Utrecht University publishes three award tiers rather than one: €5,000, €10,000 and €15,000, all paid in the first year of studies even for a two-year programme.
Nuffic states the programme is made available jointly with 47 Dutch higher education institutions, which will grant scholarships to 2,112 students per academic year.
coverage: A one-off grant of € 5,000 paid in the first year of studies (Study in NL and Radboud University figures).
Nothing else. Study in NL states it is not a full-tuition scholarship; Radboud University states the costs of living and studying in the Netherlands are not covered.
requirements: Apply for an NL Scholarship-eligible programme at a participating institution and meet that institution's admission and scholarship requirements.
Utrecht University: your application must be submitted before 1 February, 23:59 CET; the application portal closes at that time and selection only starts after the deadline.
Utrecht University: results are aimed to be published by mid-April.

Utrecht University: you must demonstrate you can cover the remaining costs by completing the Statement of Financial Resources, showing a realistic plan covering the full nominal duration of the Master's programme.

Radboud University: your OSIRIS application must be submitted by 31 January 2027, 23:59 CET at the latest, and must be complete by 14 February 2027, 23:59 CET at the latest; incomplete applications will not be considered for scholarship selection.
Radboud University: proof of English proficiency should be handed in before the 14 February 2027 deadline.
Radboud University: the decision is communicated around mid-April 2027 (date subject to change).
Nuffic operates an integrity Code of Conduct; the programme may not be involved in financial misconduct, tax or social security default, money laundering, terrorist financing or related conduct.
documents: Utrecht University: Statement of Financial Resources (PDF) showing how the applicant will fund the full nominal duration of the programme.
Radboud University: the OSIRIS application must be free of incorrect, illegible or missing documents by the completeness deadline.
Radboud University: proof of English proficiency is requested before 14 February 2027.
Utrecht University: an application for an NL Scholarship-eligible master's programme at Utrecht University, submitted through the OSIRIS Online Application account.
application_method: Choose a participating Dutch institution and an NL Scholarship-eligible programme (not every programme participates).
Apply for admission to that programme through the institution's own application system.
Radboud University: indicate during the OSIRIS application procedure for a Master's programme that you wish to apply for an NL Scholarship.

Utrecht University: submit the application for an NL Scholarship-eligible MA programme, log in to your OSIRIS Online Application account, locate 'NL Scholarship' under your dashboard, click 'View/Edit' for the scholarship linked to your chosen programme, open the application form, answer all required questions and submit.
Meet your institution's published deadline and completeness deadline.
Upload all required documents, including the institutional financial-plans form where required.
Await the selection outcome, published by the institution after its deadline.
existing.selection_notes: Utrecht University assesses applications on the academic background shown in the master's programme application, the motivation explaining the relevance of the time in the Netherlands and at Utrecht University to future goals, and the quality and feasibility of the financial plan. Radboud University assesses on academic excellence (outstanding study results, relevance of the previous degree to the programme, ranking of the university where previous degrees were obtained) and ambition (quality and relevance of the motivation letter, promise shown by achievements, life experience and extracurricular activities such as internships or volunteering), with each faculty considering its own applicants individually. Admission to the programme and selection for the scholarship are two separate processes.
existing.best_fit: Non-EEA nationals applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at one of the listed participating Dutch research universities or universities of applied sciences who can fund the remainder of tuition and living costs themselves.
existing.notes: This is not full funding and should never be budgeted as such: Study in NL states it is not a full-tuition scholarship and Radboud University states explicitly that the costs of living and studying in the Netherlands are not covered. At Radboud University the award is limited to one year and can only be received once. The programme was renamed from Holland Scholarship to NL Scholarship in June 2023, so older material under the old name may be out of date. Selection for the scholarship is separate from admission to the programme — an admission offer does not imply a scholarship. Utrecht University requires applicants to prove they can cover the full remaining cost of the programme.
existing.application_period: Annual cycle: applications for an academic year open on 1 November of the preceding calendar year and close on institution-specific dates earlier in the year. The central page published the 2026-2027 opening date of 1 November 2025 and had not yet published a 2027-2028 opening date when checked.
existing.deadline_display: The application for the academic year 2026-2027 opened on 1 November 2025. Please check the website of the institution you want to apply to for the specific deadline(s).

existing.funding_period: one-time award for one academic year

existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants planning to start a Master's programme at Erasmus University Rotterdam who are considered high achieving students and are unable to finance their study themselves. Eligibility details and nationality rules are set by each participating school.
benefits: Contribution to the statutory tuition fee
application_method: Check the participating school's own scholarship page for the school-specific application process
Apply through the channel named by that school
existing.selection_notes: The Erasmus Trustfonds was founded to support research and education projects organised by Erasmus University Rotterdam specifically, and the fund aims to contribute to the growth and flourishing of the university. Selection criteria, documentation and ranking are decided per participating school, so applicants must read the page of the school they apply to.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving incoming Master's students at Erasmus University Rotterdam who cannot finance their own study, and who read and follow the internal deadlines of the specific school administering their programme.
existing.notes: The central university page lists nine participating schools - ESL, ESSB, ESHCC, ESHPM, RSM (administered on rsm.nl), ESE, ESPhil, EMC - each with its own procedure, and the RSM page is hosted on the separate rsm.nl domain. Several schools cap the award and add their own tuition-fee waiver, so the practical package differs by school. General contact: scholarships@eur.nl.
